About.label: About me!
About.title: Want to know more about me? Sure:
About.paragraph1: I am a Junior Developer and Information Systems student, passionate about technology and the development of digital experiences.
About.paragraph2: I have practical experience developing web and mobile applications, working with technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and React Native, as well as knowledge of back-end development.
About.paragraph3: Currently, I am deepening my knowledge of TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Next.js, and Node.js, seeking to grow technically and apply good software development practices.
